exposure: maternal pre-existing type II diabetes mellitus
cohort: Mothers who delivered via Cesarean section and participated in the Phase 8 (2016-2019) Pregnancy Risk Assessment Monitoring System (PRAMS) in the United States.
finding: Mothers delivering via CS with pre-existing or gestational HBP or gestational diabetes had a lower incidence of infant mortality, while infants born to mothers with pre-existing/gestational diabetes, HBP, or depression experienced longer hospital stays and higher rates of low birth weight.
mod_finding: For mothers with pre-existing or gestational high blood pressure or gestational diabetes, CS deliveries were associated with a lower incidence of infant mortality.
